'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Nick Swedal DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Swedal]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
